title: Too young to sing in Chicago clubs
summary: She was not singing in Chicago clubs because she was too young; she began after returning from Detroit and recalls getting in with a pianist friend.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: What were you doing in Chicago then?
But you weren't singing in the clubs?
You were singing in the clubs?
Oh, no, I wasn't singing in clubs then.
When did you start singing in the clubs?
After I come back from Detroit.
Oh, you didn't sing in the clubs in Chicago?

I was too young, I was too young in those days, I didn't know how to do -- I didn't know (unintelligible). I was too young to go in them clubs (unintelligible). They wouldn't let me go in places. After it got to be (unintelligible), I knew a lot of people here. I knew a lot of girls here, (Unintelligible). I used to play the (unintelligible). (Laughter.)
And all they wanted to know, could you play the piano and sing? And Bess (?) would get to the piano and play and I would sing. And they let us in there. (Unintelligible).
